response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of software engineering experience and a valuable entrepreneurial background as a founder, he lacks the specialized AI focus required for this Director-level role. His AI experience is limited to his most recent position, missing the deep, recognized AI expertise and strategic cloud/AI platform leadership expected. He is a strong Staff-level full-stack engineer, but falls short of the requirements for a Principal AI Strategy position.
strengths: Meets the minimum requirement of 15 years of diverse software and infrastructure engineering experience.
Brings valuable entrepreneurial and startup experience as the founder of GISCollective.
Proven track record of inspiring others internally and externally through workshops, conference talks, and open-source contributions.
concerns: Lacks deep, recognized expertise in AI and ML, with AI exposure seemingly limited to his most recent role.
Career trajectory and scope align more with Staff/Senior Full-Stack engineering rather than a Director-level Principal Strategist.
Does not possess the preferred Master's or PhD in an AI-related field.
